mechanism.summary: Reuse the active direct-leaf frame for a statically adjacent self-bytecode tail call when no caller cleanup state remains.
mechanism.generality: The route is selected only by runtime bytecode identity, an existing direct-leaf callee, and an exact return-tail position; it does not inspect source paths, workload names, or iteration counts.
semantic_risks: tail-position detection and caller operand preservation
direct this and parameter slot isolation
fallback for eval with generators async constructors proxies and bound functions
